item.title: The Burden
item.description:
This short post is a coalescing of two thoughts in my brain at the moment:

  1. The burden of responsibility when reviewing an AI generated change set from a colleague.
  2. The surface level understanding of codebases when AI is heavily involved.

You could write essays upon essays for those statements. But I’m going to be quick.

item.title: Working with Zed for a week
item.description:
I took Zed for a spin this week, and this post covers what I noticed whilst using it as my day-to-day editor.

I love it, and I'm probably going to stay with it (but I miss a debugger).

Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter. It’s also open source.
